title: General post-transform records, conservative tile bins and two-engine full-record replay

contract.payload: Complete WindowPrimitive and raster state plus immutable fragment/test/blend state handle, pass-wide bin sequence and token. Retain all16varying slots/64components per vertex, generated clip metadata, draw-local64-bit primitive sequence, exact viewport origin, signed64 fixed XY, extended local XY/reciprocal W, depth and shader point size. No VS scratch reference survives acceptance.

record_layout.format: Configuration-specific internal word format, independent of Bundle packing; lexicographic Record/numeric Vec leaves. Scalars occupy one/two words and never cross a64-byte line. Canonical signed/unsigned padding and zero reserved words. Header retains identity and record ordinal. Not a new native software ABI.

contract.bounds: Checked aligned arena; widened base+ordinal*recordBytes+recordBytes <=exclusive limit<=4GiB, including a final record ending exactly at4GiB. Record ordinal differs from legacy64-byte state-cache handles.
contract.publication: All uncached line-store acknowledgements precede the first bin-reference offer. Each nonempty record is stored once. Complete private reads validate header/padding/identity before successful publication; replay additionally matches bin state/sequence/token.
contract.binning: Widened signed bounding rectangle intersects screen/scissor. Point/line bounds use clamped size and shader point-size selection. Empty bounds consume no records. Unavailable guard-band fixed coordinates conservatively fan out across the effective scissor and remain available to downstream guard/numeric policy. Tile log2 ranges3..6 and grid fits65535IDs.
contract.order: Strictly increasing pass-wide32-bit sequences, independent of stored draw-local64-bit sequence/clip part. Row-major fanout waits for every append result. State handles and tokens remain immutable.
contract.failure: Record exhaustion before any store returns the exact unpublished input. Bin rejection may follow partial fanout and invalidates the pass, without claiming a restartable prefix. Resume bindings are rejected. Memory errors never create a successful partial record.
contract.ownership: Separate record, bin-page and directory arenas; matching identity and grid. Each engine owns one tile through full-record and tile-result acceptance. Other engines keep independent dispatch slots and tags. End closes bins after producer drain. Completion retains memory queues/acks, readers, held outputs and tile results. The enclosing owner still pins shader/image/state resources and waits downstream raster/FS/pixel publication.
contract.cancellation: Drain producer-held append through an acknowledgement bridge, synthesizing a failed reply after a closed directory when needed; then cancel bins. Preserve offered record/memory/child-end controls and outputs. A held completion does not admit a new binding.
contract.scope: Post-viewport stream integration. Does not connect actual shared-CU vertex ownership, native host admission or fragment/typed-image execution. It does not validate general resource-table permissions or implement guard clipping, continuation/reuse caches or throughput/PPA closure.

coverage: Three complete full-capacity randomized scalar round trips, all329payload leaves, canonical signed padding, corrupt headers/reserved words, store/read faults, held offers/results and healthy reuse.
Bounds, maximal invalid ordinals, short/misaligned arenas and a full record ending exactly at4GiB without wrap.
Triangle/line/point fanout, shader point size, outside rejection, conservative guard fallback, signed extreme coordinates/scissor, strict sequence and exact exhaustion restart.

Actual paged bin directory with two resident entries and nine tiles, two real bin-chain readers and two independent full-record readers: four stored records produce26ordered references; stalled engine0 retains its output while engine1 completes at least three tiles. Every emitted payload scalar matches its input.

Overlapping arenas, grid/identity mismatch and resume rejected before memory traffic; six integrated fault cases: record store, bin store, bin exhaustion, record read, bad record header and bin-record state mismatch, each followed by exact healthy reuse.
Cancel while memory and full-record outputs are held, withheld tile results, no early pass summary, complete acknowledgement drain and exact reuse.
Twenty-three unchanged TileBinReplayPass/TileBinDirectory checks cover linked chains, mid-pass seal, cancellation, isolation, paged evictions, ordering, backing limits and continuation history.
validation.limits: Records use full16-slot capacity and real bin/scheduler logic; fixture window values are not outputs of actual vertex shaders and are not rasterized here. This proves stream storage/replay and its local fault ownership, not native rendering, VM/reset or image publication.

mobile_replay.scope: Two characterized256x32 report SRAMs. Full-record snapshots, queues, metadata and control use additional registers. No new CU, payload pool or scalar FMA/divider. Structural counts do not qualify the total Mobile budget or synthesis PPA.

remaining: Bind actual vertex/clip/viewport draws and immutable fragment state to the general bin owner, keeping source/VM/payload ownership through source completion.
Resolve fragment/test/blend state and integrate multiple typed tile-image engines, tile scissor selection, backing loads/stores/resolves and acknowledged publication.
Native GPU-memory admission, allocation/resource permission provenance, shared-CU task/payload routing, MMU/reset/fault drain and exact cached-consumer tests on the new general-bin path.
Post-transform indexed-vertex reuse, bin continuation/record lifetimes, guard-band reconstruction, production storage/rate/occupancy and synthesis-only PPA qualification.
Remaining original H0-H8 feature/qualification requirements; no new place-and-route requirement.
